# autotask-mcp

[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.11-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://www.python.org/)
[![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-FastMCP-blue?logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHdpZHRoPSIyNCIgaGVpZ2h0PSIyNCIgdmlld0JveD0iMCAwIDI0IDI0Ij48Y2lyY2xlIGN4PSIxMiIgY3k9IjEyIiByPSIxMCIgZmlsbD0id2hpdGUiLz48L3N2Zz4=)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/)
[![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-Containerized-2496ED?logo=docker&logoColor=white)](https://www.docker.com/)
[![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-Cache-DC382D?logo=redis&logoColor=white)](https://redis.io/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![Claude Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20with-Claude%20Code-DA7857?logo=anthropic)](https://claude.ai/code)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Alzarak%2Fautotask--mcp-blue?logo=github)](https://github.com/Alzarak/autotask-mcp)

## Overview

Standalone MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for the Autotask PSA REST API. Built on FastMCP with Streamable HTTP transport, it exposes 24 tools for querying tickets, companies, projects, contracts, time entries, charges, User Defined Fields, and more -- consumable by Claude Desktop, Claude CLI, and any MCP-compatible client.

Runs as a single Docker container with two transport modes: **stdio** for Claude Desktop/CLI integration, or **HTTP** (port 8523) for remote access. Features a two-tier cache (in-memory L1 + SQLite or Redis L2), background delta sync for tickets and charges, billing classification, configurable data retention filtering, and read-side User Defined Field (UDF) discovery, filtering, and coercion.

## Architecture

```
Claude Desktop / CLI  --(stdio)--> autotask-mcp (FastMCP)
                                        |
                                  Autotask REST API
                                        |
                              SQLite L2 cache (/data/cache)
```

```
MCP Client  --(HTTP :8523)--> autotask-mcp (FastMCP)
                                    |
                              Autotask REST API
                                    |
                         Redis or SQLite L2 cache
```

## Project Metrics

| Metric | Count |
|--------|-------|
| MCP Tools | 24 |
| Entity Types (get) | 36 |
| Entity Types (search) | 29 |
| UDF-Aware Entities | 19 |
| Python Source Files | 17 |
| Lines of Python | ~16,300 |
| Test Files | 40 |
| Config Files | 4 |

## Tool Surface

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `get_entity` | Fetch single entity by ID (36 entity types, optional UDF coercion + projection) |
| `search_entity` | Search entities by filters (29 entity types, optional `udf_filter` + UDF coercion) |
| `search_attachments` | Search file attachments by parent (5 parent types) |
| `search_picklist_values` | Picklist values for any entity field (`is_udf="true"` resolves UDF picklists) |
| `list_udf_definitions` | UDF schema per entity (name, label, dataType, isPickList, picklistValues) for 19 entity types |
| `search_tickets` | Full ticket search with assignment, filters, notes query, enrichment, optional `udf_filter` + UDF coercion |
| `count_tickets` | Count tickets matching filters |
| `sub_issue_analytics` | Sub-issue analytics (3 breakdown modes) |
| `group_tickets` | Group/count tickets by field with optional hours aggregation |
| `search_ticket_notes` | Ticket note + time entry history |
| `search_time_entries` | Time entries with billing classification |
| `get_ticket_hours` | Aggregated billing hours per ticket |
| `search_ticket_charges` | Charge records by ticket |
| `search_project_charges` | Charge records by project |
| `get_ticket_charge_totals` | Aggregated charge totals per ticket |
| `get_project_charge_totals` | Aggregated charge totals per project |
| `check_api_connection` | API health check |
| `get_sync_status` | Sync and cache health status |
| `create_excel_document` | Generic OneDrive Excel export via Graph |
| `create_word_document` | Generic OneDrive Word export via Graph |
| `export_tickets_to_excel` | Ticket-specific Excel export |
| `export_tickets_to_word` | Ticket-specific Word export |
| `search_task_predecessors` | Task dependency queries |
| `search_task_secondary_resources` | Task secondary resource assignments |

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Docker (recommended) or Python 3.11+
- Autotask PSA API credentials (username, secret, integration code, base URL)

### Environment Variables

Create a `.env` file with your Autotask API credentials:

```env
# Required
AUTOTASK_API_USERNAME=apiuser@company.com
AUTOTASK_API_SECRET=your-api-secret
AUTOTASK_API_INTEGRATION_CODE=your-integration-code
AUTOTASK_BASE_URL=https://webservicesX.autotask.net/ATServicesRest

# Optional -- billing classification overrides
# Comma-separated lists of Autotask billingCodeID integers that should
# always classify as billable / non-billable, regardless of the record's
# isNonBillable flag. Leave blank to fall through to the flag.
BILLING_CODE_NON_BILLABLE_IDS=
BILLING_CODE_BILLABLE_IDS=

# Optional -- data retention (years). 0 or blank disables filtering.
DATA_RETENTION_YEARS=4
```

See [`.env.example`](.env.example) for the full list of recognized variables (cache config, Redis auth, sync intervals, etc.).

### Docker (Recommended)

```bash
# Build
docker build -t autotask-mcp:standalone .

# Run with stdio transport (Claude Desktop/CLI)
docker run --rm -i --env-file .env \
  -v autotask-cache:/data/cache \
  -e TRANSPORT=stdio \
  autotask-mcp:standalone

# Run with HTTP transport (port 8523)
docker run --rm -it --env-file .env \
  -v autotask-cache:/data/cache \
  -p 8523:8523 \
  autotask-mcp:standalone
```

### Docker Compose (with optional Redis)

```bash
# Without Redis (SQLite L2 cache)
docker compose up -d

# With Redis L2 cache
docker compose --profile redis up -d
```

### Local Development

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python3 src/autotask_server.py      # starts on :8523
curl http://localhost:8523/health
```

### Transport Modes

| Mode | Use Case | Cache |
|------|----------|-------|
| `stdio` | Claude Desktop / CLI | SQLite L2 (auto) |
| `http` | Remote / multi-client | Redis or SQLite L2 |

## Repository Structure

│   ├── charge_sync.py             # Background charge sync

│   ├── time_entries_sync.py       # Background time entries sync
│   ├── billing_codes.py           # Billable/non-billable classification

│   ├── graph_client.py            # Microsoft Graph / OneDrive exports
│   ├── picklist_utils.py          # Picklist value resolution

## Cache System

**L1 (Memory):** In-process LRU cache, 100 MB limit, sub-millisecond reads.

**L2 (Redis or SQLite):** Persistent cache, 1 GB limit, 30-day TTL. Redis used in Docker Compose / cloud; SQLite auto-selected for stdio transport.

| Entity | TTL |
|--------|-----|
| Companies | 24 hours |
| Picklists | 1 hour |
| UDF schema | 1 hour |
| Entity lookups | 5 minutes |
| Search results | 1 minute |

## Background Sync

- **Tickets:** Delta sync via `lastActivityDate`, 5-minute interval. First run fetches all; subsequent runs fetch only changes.
- **Charges:** 15-minute interval.
- **Notes / Time Entries:** Configurable intervals, disabled by default in stdio mode.

Sync jobs store data in cache batches (Redis or SQLite) for efficient retrieval by search tools. All sync schedulers are disabled by default in stdio mode.

## Customization

### Company Name Aliases

`config/company_aliases.yaml` maps shorthand strings to the full company names
in your Autotask tenant, so callers can pass things like `"ACME"` to ticket
search. The shipped file is a small generic example -- replace its contents
with your own list, or drop a `config/company_aliases.local.yaml` next to it.
The loader picks the `.local.yaml` variant first when both are present, which
keeps your real list out of source control. The Dockerfile's `COPY` glob
copies both files into the image at build time when present.

### Billing Classification

`classify_billability()` in `src/billing_codes.py` decides whether a time
entry or charge counts as billable. It first checks two env-var overrides
(`BILLING_CODE_NON_BILLABLE_IDS` and `BILLING_CODE_BILLABLE_IDS`), then falls
back to the record's `isNonBillable` flag, defaulting to billable when both
sources are null. Provide each variable as a comma-separated list of
`billingCodeID` integers from your Autotask tenant.

## User Defined Fields (UDFs)

The server provides read-side UDF support across 19 entity types (company,
ticket, task, project, resource, asset, contact, contract, service_call,
configuration_item_note, and others). UDF schema is fetched lazily from
`/entityInformation/{entity}/userDefinedFields` and cached in the dedicated
`udf` namespace for one hour.

**Discover UDF schema** with `list_udf_definitions`:

```jsonc
{ "entity": "ticket" }
// → [{ "name": "ClientPONumber", "label": "Client PO #", "dataType": "string",
//      "isPickList": false, "isRequired": false, "picklistValues": [] }, ...]
```

**Surface UDFs in responses** via the `fields` parameter on read tools:

| Token | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| `"full"` | Default tier plus all `userDefinedFields` |
| `"+udfs"` | Default tier plus all `userDefinedFields` |
| `"udf:ClientPONumber,udf:Region"` | Default tier plus the named UDFs |

Default/minimal tiers continue to omit UDFs to preserve token budget.

**Filter by a UDF value** with `udf_filter` on `search_entity` and
`search_tickets`:

```jsonc
{
  "entity": "company",
  "udf_filter": { "field": "Region", "op": "eq", "value": "Northeast" }
}
```

Autotask permits a single UDF clause per query. When `udf_filter` is set on
`search_tickets`, the local ticket cache is bypassed so the predicate is
always evaluated server-side.

**Coerce UDF values to their declared dataType** with `coerce_udfs="true"`
(default) on `get_entity`, `search_entity`, and `search_tickets`. UDF values
returned by Autotask as JSON strings are cast to int, float, bool, or ISO
datetime according to the cached schema. Multi-select and reference UDFs are
passed through unchanged. Set `coerce_udfs="false"` to receive raw strings.

**Resolve UDF picklist labels** with `search_picklist_values` by passing
`is_udf="true"` -- UDF picklists are not exposed through the standard
`/PicklistValues` route and are read from `entityInformation/userDefinedFields`
instead.
